chunks: For they were seized by the torment. Verily there was a sign in this, but most of them did not believe.
ai.seo_question: Why did most people not believe despite clear signs?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse underscores the tragic irony that the majority of the Prophet's contemporaries, despite witnessing the clear signs of his mission, remained disbelievers, thereby inviting divine punishment. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a lesson in the distinction between numerical majority and spiritual truth, emphasizing that faith requires active recognition of signs rather than passive adherence to the crowd.
